facts.note: At nine, by the temple bell, Aurèle had everyone show him their watches, and Vauthier's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by Vauthier's watch; he went to the hall to fetch his cigar case from his coat; Madame began playing the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back.
At the temple's strike of ten during the game, Vauthier saw the salon clock at five minutes to ten and remarked on it to Madame.
